extra.summary: DBS Live Fresh Student Card is one of the best starter cashback student credit cards in Singapore. Benefits include annual fee waivers, no minimum spend and income, and attractive 5% cash back on McDelivery, Netflix, and more. This credit card comes with a S$500 credit limit.

our_takes.our-take: The DBS Live Fresh Student Card is tailored for students aged 21-27 in local universities and polytechnics seeking a first credit card. Earning 5% cashback on merchants like Golden Village and McDonald's aligns with student lifestyles, but be mindful of the $15 cap per category. The additional 5% "Green Cashback" on eco-friendly purchases, capped at $15, may appeal to environmentally conscious students. While offering a 5-year annual fee waiver and no minimum spend, the card's $500 credit limit is restrictive and you will need to spend sustainably and at certain merchants to maximise it.
our_takes.good-for:
* Students who frequently purchase coffee or fast food and want to earn cashback on these expenses.
* Students who enjoy streaming movies and music, seeking cashback on subscriptions like Netflix or Spotify.
* Eco-conscious students looking to support sustainable businesses and earn extra cashback on green purchases.
our_takes.things-to-note:
* Late payment fees of S$100 can negate cashback earnings; always pay on time to avoid this fee.
* A 27.80% annual interest rate applies if you don't pay in full; interest charges add up quickly.
* The maximum S$50 monthly cashback cap limits rewards; plan spending to maximize within the limit.
